title: Missing Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy response header
description: The response omits Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy, so the document is not cross-origin isolated. Without the header a cross-origin subresource that refuses CORP or CORS is not gated by an explicit policy, and isolation-gated features such as SharedArrayBuffer stay unavailable. Isolation is opt-in and costs compatibility, so absence is a hardening gap to weigh rather than a defect on its own.
remediation: Send Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp only on documents that need cross-origin isolation, and make every embedded resource carry CORP or CORS. Leave the header absent on documents that do not need isolation and record that decision.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot tell whether the document needs isolation, and it does not see the CORP or CORS headers on the resources that decide whether require-corp can be deployed.
